verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Loops itself generating AI insights or suggestions from user data inside the product. The MCP server, CLI and agent skills let external AI agents read and write Loops data, which is a developer building block rather than an in-product AI feature. The revenue-attribution reporting and Guardian checks are not described as AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
